BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Menti!!
I wonder where all those Coenubias went...\nThere were so many of them earlier though.
Aaaaaaah!
That's Zianga's voice!
In order to treat Zianga's wounds, the group moved\nto a safer place...
How is he?
Hmm...It doesn't seem like he took many hits, but\nthere are quite a few deep wounds.
I guess he must have got hit at very close range.\nI wonder how the attacker got so close to him...
It's either the attacker was incredibly fast or he\nwas caught completely off guard...Anyway, we need\nto stay alert until he regains consciousness...
...Hey, Muti, what's your take on this? When we\nwere gonna wipe out all those Coenubias, they got\naway. And when we moved on, we got ambushed.
Then Zianga who was left alone was attacked and\ninjured severely...I can't help but think that the\nenemies know everything about our plan.
And it all began since the Eumano siblings joined\nus...
Pelulu! Do you think those two did it?! I mean,\ncome on, how could someone that tiny injure Zianga\nlike that? It doesn't make any sense.
Those kids are some of the last remaining Eumanos\non the mainland, you know?!
A-alright, I'm sorry for suspecting that they did\nit...
If you're going to find Coenubias, don't you think\nI should come with you?
We'd really like you to come with us, but we can't\nleave someone who is seriously injured and\nunconscious here alone, right?
Besides, if you're also not here, we have no one\nto look after those two kids...
!! Pelulu...
Uhm...hm?\nOh, you're back!\nSorry, I think I dozed off for a bit...
Huh? Pelulu?\nI thought she was with you...
I don't think she's back yet...Because if she had\ncome back and seen me sleeping, she'd probably\nhave woken me up...
First, Zianga was badly injured, then Pelulu went\nmissing...This can't be a coincidence...
...I got it.\nI'll go find Pelulu. Please take care of Zianga\nand the kids...
Ahaha...\nOh, when did you figure it out?
I know you wanted to get rid of me before\nI regained consciousness, but too bad, that's not\ngonna happen!
Who would have thought that you could actually\nsend out signals through that sound your sister\nmakes while chewing those leaves?
You were able to inform the Coenubias of our every\nmove without us noticing, and that's how they\nfound out everything about our plan...
You've been getting rid of everyone who caught on\nto your sister's trick, right?
You're quite something, I admit that...\nBut failing to finish me off was your big mistake!
No way...that can't be true! They're definitely\nEumanos!! I don't believe it! I don't believe that\nthey're Coenubias!!
Unfortunately, it's true...
Ahahaha!\nInteresting! How did you get out?
Crushing the rock that was blocking the cave with\nthis wasn't easy, you know~!!
Just before the rock crashed down and blocked the\ncave entrance, I caught a glimpse of your\nsister...
But unfortunately, what I saw wasn't a Eumano...
Whaaat?!
Ahahaha!\nMy sister, Menti, she just looks a little bit\ndifferent, you see!
Ahahaha!!\nMenti, they all want you to play with them!\nC'mon, play with them! Ahahahaha!!
This is insane...ugh!!
Oh noooo, Menti! Mentiii!!
No, don't! Ohh!!
Aaaaaaah!!
Cerrit just lost it after seeing Menti getting\nattacked by the Coenubia and died right in front\nof him...
The Coenubias must have sent a monster disguised\nas his sister to trick and manipulate him to\nattack the Eumano village...
I'll never forgive those Coenubias...!
To avenge the Eumanos and to ensure nobody else\nsuffers like Cerrit and Menti...I'll definitely\ncrush them!!
Welp, since Zianga hasn't fully recovered and Muti\nis also wounded, let's return to the ark for now!
